Record Class AcceptedEntry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.AcceptedEntry
Record Components:
key - the stable Finding.key() this entry accepts
count - expected number of observations per session
reason - why the finding is accepted — carried into the receipt
since - ISO date the acceptance was recorded
entryMode - per-entry enforcement override: LedgerMode.REPORT exempts this entry's over-counts from gating while the global mode is gate (onboarding); null inherits the global mode
public record AcceptedEntry(String key, int count, String reason, String since, LedgerMode entryMode) extends Record
One accepted finding in the committed ledger, with its expected count.

Count semantics keep acceptance visible without being noisy: observed equal to count lists under ACCEPTED; observed above it surfaces the delta under ATTENTION; observed below it surfaces a ratchet opportunity.
